an7.84:1.1: sattime bhikkhave adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā uppannuppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya.
an7.84:1.3: sammukhāvinayo dātabbo sativinayo dātabbo amūḷhavinayo dātabbo paṭiññātakaraṇaṃ yebhuyyasikā tassa pāpiyasikā tiṇavatthārako.
an7.84:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave satta adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā uppannuppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāyāti.
